previous_query_failures: Generic CONTAINS(POINT(...)) query failed with ESO geography latitude error; switched to documented s_region field.
Individual-exposure tool outputs were truncated, so they were not retained or used as complete exports; aggregate response below is complete.

parameters.QUERY: SELECT main_id,ra,dec,pmra,pmdec,coo_bibcode,pm_bibcode FROM basic JOIN ident ON oidref=oid WHERE id IN ('GJ 447','GJ 588','GJ 784')

SELECT target,slit_path,filter_path,ins_mode,dp_tech,dp_type,COUNT(*) AS n,MIN(dp_id) AS first_id,MAX(dp_id) AS last_id FROM dbo.raw WHERE instrument='CRIRES' AND date_obs >= '2021-06-01' AND date_obs < '2026-09-07' AND (CONTAINS(s_region,CIRCLE('',176.93498861725834,0.8045556493308333,0.025))=1 OR CONTAINS(s_region,CIRCLE('',233.05388462875788,-41.27559178719,0.025))=1 OR CONTAINS(s_region,CIRCLE('',303.4724843743875,-45.16401959745389,0.025))=1) AND dp_tech LIKE 'SPECTRUM%' AND (dp_type='OBJECT' OR dp_type='STD,RV') GROUP BY target,slit_path,filter_path,ins_mode,dp_tech,dp_type

metadata.description: All filters.  The string is in the format <value>,<value>,... where <value> is the value of one of the keywords INS.FILT*.NAME
